5115061.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Gresham / East County
5115061.note: Jewish Review (Jewish Federation of Greater Portland, 'New Chabad Center fosters Jewish life in Gresham', undated, before their first Chanukah menorah lighting in Gresham): 'About a year after moving to Portland in fall of 2019 to teach in Maimonides Jewish Day School, the Dyces started reaching out to Jewish people living in the East County. Being in pandemic times, they turned to ... social media'; 'We really started at absolutely nothing'. Rabbi Avrohom Dyce, 12 Sept 2022 (Shluchim Office, on CrownHeights.info): 'About 3 years ago, we moved to Portland, Oregon to teach for a year in the Chabad school there'; 'After that year when our job was up ... we started looking into Jewish life in Gresham'; 'we moved out as the first Shluchim to Greshem.' Lubavitch.com, 2 May 2022 ('New Shluchim To Gresham, Oregon'): 'With the Covid-19 pandemic at its height, they began reaching out to locals through social media'; 'within a few months' Rabbi Moshe Wilhelm 'appointed them official emissaries to Gresham.' Medium: 2020 is counted back ('about a year after' fall 2019); its chabad.org listing went up 2 June 2021.

5801568.name: Chabad of Corvallis
5801568.note: CrownHeights.info, 6 Sept 2023 ('New Chabad Center Being Established In Corvallis, Oregon'): Rabbi Menachem and Zahava Angster: 'We are overjoyed to be opening the first ever Chabad center for Corvallis and Oregon State University'; 'After visiting for over a year, we see a city and campus that is full of opportunity.' Its chabad.org listing went up 1 Feb 2023.

4494283.name: Tigard Chabad Jewish Center
4494283.note: Oregon Jewish Life, 29 Aug 2019 ('August Biz Ins: ... Chabad in Tigard ...', Deborah Moon): 'Chabad Center opens in Tigard. Rabbi Menachem and Chaya Orenstein recently relocated from Brooklyn, NY, to Tigard to open a new Jewish center'; 'Tigard Chabad will feature programs including Shabbat dinners, children's activities and more.' Its chabad.org listing went up 5 Nov 2019.
